behavior: Retain ASCII alphanumeric characters and ._-/; replace each other Unicode scalar with one underscore.
Trim leading and trailing underscores; select unspecified when the entire input contains no ASCII alphanumeric character.

interface.source_contract: Successive byte windows of a valid UTF-8 string; windows may split scalars.
interface.output_capacity: at least the current source length
interface.workspace: Byte 0 holds the grammar phase 0..6 or finalized phase 7; byte 1 is the final-frame flag 0 or 1.
interface.error_effect: The current call leaves output and workspace unchanged; prior successful frames remain committed.

behavior: Require # and an initial L; the optional range starts at the first hyphen and requires another L.
Replace the initial # with a colon and omit each endpoint's initial L.
Replace the first C in each endpoint with a colon; preserve later C and hyphen bytes exactly.
Preserve the original acceptance of empty and nonnumeric endpoint bodies; retain Unicode bytes unchanged.

interface.source_contract: Borrowed UTF-8 windows; re-present an unconsumed partial scalar with the next window.
interface.output_wire: u64 consumed-source-prefix length little-endian followed by escaped bytes
interface.workspace: Byte 0 is open (0) or finalized (1); byte 1 is the final-frame flag 0 or 1.
interface.success_return: total output bytes including the eight-byte header
interface.error_effect: The current call leaves output and workspace unchanged; prior writer effects are not rolled back.

behavior: Preserve ASCII fragment bytes and encode other Unicode scalars as lowercase JSON Unicode escapes, including surrogate pairs.
Validate canonical UTF-8; a nonfinal incomplete scalar remains unconsumed, while a final incomplete scalar is rejected.

interface.source_contract: Operations 0/1 validate arbitrary UTF-8 bytes; 4/5 require valid UTF-8 borrowed from Rust &str; 2/3 require empty source.
interface.request: Read-only 16-byte workspace: little-endian u64 operation, budget.
interface.output_wire: Five little-endian u64 values: prefix_end, suffix_start, removed_units, original_tokens, kind. Scalar operations return value followed by four zero fields.
interface.error_effect: Every returned error preserves the complete source, request and output. Successful calls preserve the request and output beyond byte 39.

behavior: Assign the odd byte-budget remainder to the suffix and move both cut points to UTF-8 boundaries.

Borrow arbitrarily large valid strings without a bootstrap-capacity input limit or a Rust algorithm fallback.

interface.invalid_operation: trap; all 64 operation bits are significant
interface.value_domain: all u64 values, including u64::MAX as a valid input and result

profiles.strict: Operations 0..7 preserve complete canonical UTF8 validation before span validation and output admission.

profiles.production_precondition: Every source in the safe Rust adapter is a borrowed &str or concatenated String/Cow<str>; only the private typed Operation enum selects the trusted profile.
profiles.base_operation: operation & 7; bit 0 selects query/emit; all operation values above 15 are INVALID.

Separate logical replacement positions from bounded physical take counts, including valid usize::MAX skips/deletes.

Rust retains and compacts storage from HIA-selected spans; no parsing, replacement selection or render/reparse fallback.

materialization.owner: Rust computes storage bounds only; HIA chooses every logical row and span.
materialization.parse: Direct emit when input bytes <=256, with at most one result row per byte; larger inputs use exact query then emit.
materialization.apply: Direct emit when checked(old_line_count + inserted_count) <=256; otherwise exact query then emit.
materialization.line_texts: Direct emit with old_line_count records as the proven bound.
materialization.into_contents: Direct emit with checked(2 * old_line_count) records as the proven bound.
materialization.capacity: Checked 40 + 32 * record_bound allocation; validate native required size and count, require required size <= buffer length, then truncate logical buffer length to the complete returned plan. Spare initialized storage never becomes a row.
materialization.fallback: The alternative is another HIA query/emit sequence; no Rust algorithm fallback.

interface.source_wire: u64 command_count, pattern_count; pattern_count groups of u64 alternative_count then u64 byte_length and bytes per alternative; min(command_count, pattern_count) length-prefixed command strings. All integers little-endian.
interface.source_contract: At least one pattern group; exactly one first-group alternative; later groups may have zero alternatives. Entire frame must be structurally valid and have no trailing bytes before matching.
interface.output_wire: u64 pattern_count for a match or zero for no match, little-endian
interface.workspace: Unused; never read or written; null with zero length accepted.
interface.error_effect: Output unchanged; source/workspace never modified. Success writes only output bytes 0..8.
interface.word_operations: Native buffer.load.u64.le and buffer.store.u64.le after explicit complete-frame/capacity validation; byte-exact 0..7 tail.
interface.preflight_scope: The public Rust adapter passes counts to HIA before frame sizing/allocation. HIA 0 is NoMatch, 1 requires complete framing, and every other result is an error. The raw prefix_match frame contract remains unchanged and still validates its entire supplied frame before any match result.
interface.frame_storage: Checked complete-frame capacity <=512 uses stack storage; larger frames retain reserved Vec append. Both use the same encoder and one existing full-frame HIA call.

interface.precedence: pattern_count == 0 is invalid before the command-count comparison.
interface.side_effects: No buffers, string reads, allocations or pointer inputs.
interface.rust_dispatch: 0 returns None, 1 continues to checked framing, every other status panics; Rust does not compare either count for matching or any string.

candidate_modules.behavior: HIA owns the count decision before the adapter sizes or copies a pattern. Empty and short commands avoid the full-frame copy; admitted commands retain the complete validated prefix_match frame and byte comparisons. This helper belongs to the existing prefix algorithm and is not another complete owner migration.

interface.input: LE u64 count followed by count pairs of LE u64 kind and decision; exact length 8 + 16 * count.
interface.output: 24 bytes: LE u64 present, strictest decision, explicit-match flag; empty vector returns 0,0,0.
interface.error_contract: Output capacity first; validate the entire exact frame and all tags before writing; errors write nothing. Source and workspace never change; success preserves output beyond 24 bytes.

behavior.complete_pure_reduction: Current RuleMatch vector to presence, strictest Allow/Prompt/Forbidden decision and whether any explicit PrefixRuleMatch exists.
behavior.rust_retains: Rule traversal; callbacks; iterator/as_ref/drop/panic effects; full RuleMatch metadata/order/owned strings; serialization and checked transport. Public mutable vectors are summarized afresh, without a cached is_match result.

interface.SELECT: LE u64 mode=0,count<=64, followed by exactly count decision bytes (Allow=0,Prompt=1,Forbidden=2). Output requires 8+count and returns LE u64 selected_count plus increasing u8 batch positions; workspace unchanged.
interface.REDUCE: LE u64 mode=1,M original_count,N selected_count; exactly N records of LE u64 original_index, decision, host_length plus raw bytes. N<=M, increasing indices<M, decisions 0/2 and exact end required.
interface.REDUCE_output: Capacity>=16+8*N; LE u64 allowed_count,denied_count, then winning original indices, Allow followed by Forbidden, increasing within each group.
interface.REDUCE_workspace: Capacity>=N; writes exactly N flags (0 superseded,1 Allow,2 Forbidden). Success preserves unused output/workspace bytes.
interface.error_contract: Minimum output eight first; SELECT exact header/capacity then all tags; REDUCE complete frame then both capacities. All failures write neither output nor workspace; source is always unchanged. Raw host bytes need not be UTF-8.

behavior.complete_algorithm: Policy::compiled_network_domains: exact raw-host last non-Prompt winner and ordered Allow/Forbidden vectors.
behavior.hia_owns: SELECT excludes Prompt; REDUCE compares host bytes, chooses last winners and emits original rule indices in per-decision order.
behavior.rust_retains: Decision encoding, checked framing/capacity, structural output validation and owned final String clones. No Rust host equality, normalization, sorting or policy deduplication.
behavior.ignored_fields: Prompt hosts and every justification/protocol stay outside transport; raw from_parts hosts remain byte-exact.
behavior.error_scope: Malformed status/count/index/order/decision outputs panic with no Rust or empty-list fallback. Structurally valid but semantically wrong callee output is not proven correct by these guards; the real HIA/original-owner differential supplies semantic evidence.

interface.ADMIT: Exact LE u64 mode=0,decision (Allow=0,Prompt=1,Forbidden=2). Output eight bytes: one iff Allow, otherwise zero; workspace unchanged.
interface.PLAN: LE u64 mode=1,N, then N prefix frames. Each has token_count>=1, then token kind (Single=0,Alts=1), alternative_count and repeated byte_length/raw bytes. First token must be Single; Single has one alternative, Alts may have zero. Exact end required.
interface.PLAN_output: Three LE u64 words: rendered serialized byte count R, workspace 24*N+8+R, and output capacity 8+8*N. Workspace unchanged.
interface.RUN: Mode=2 with the same complete selected prefix frame. Workspace contains N+1 rendered offsets, two N-index arrays and R rendered bytes. Stable bottom-up merge sort compares token bytes lexicographically, then vector length; dedup emits the earliest equal rendered-vector index.
interface.RUN_output: Capacity>=8+8*N: unique count U then U selected-frame indices; writes exactly 8+8*U. Workspace requires 24*N+8+R.
interface.error_contract: Minimum output eight first; complete exact validation and checked layout before matching capacities; RUN output capacity before workspace. Errors preserve output/workspace; source always unchanged, unused successful capacity unchanged. Raw ABI bytes need not be UTF-8.
interface.empty_input: N=0 still performs PLAN/RUN: R=0, workspace eight and output eight bytes. Public owner requires no heap allocation.

behavior.complete_algorithm: Policy::get_allowed_prefixes: Allow admission, token rendering, ordered Vec<String> sorting and rendered-vector deduplication.
behavior.hia_owns: ADMIT decides Allow; PLAN sizes the rendered representation; RUN renders Single/Alts tokens, stably mergesorts vector indices and chooses unique rendered vectors.
behavior.rust_retains: Original rule iteration, as_any callbacks/downcasts, decision encoding, checked transport and structural output/UTF-8 validation, then owned result Strings. No Rust token rendering, sorting or deduplication.
behavior.effect_order: Each admitted prefix is encoded before the next callback. Non-PrefixRule, Prompt and Forbidden patterns are not inspected; callback/panic prefixes, shared-Arc inputs and independent owned outputs are preserved.
behavior.rendering: Single bytes are unchanged; Alts render exactly [ plus alternatives joined by | plus ]. Empty alternatives and delimiter-containing strings can collide; equality and ordering are on complete rendered vectors.
behavior.error_scope: Invalid native status or structural output panics with no Rust algorithm or empty-list fallback. Structurally valid wrong semantic results require the actual HIA/original-owner differential.

interface.source: LE u64 version=1 and event tag, 160-byte continuation state, exact event payload. Nine event tags BEGIN through HEURISTIC_READY.
interface.state: Magic, phase, flags, command/rule/path counters and indices, resource bits, checked sequence and zero reserved words; no global state.
interface.path_records: Rust Path::components discriminant and raw Normal OsStr encoded bytes; HIA owns component/length/byte equality. Linux native profile only, no raw-path parser or UTF-8 normalization.
interface.output: Exactly 200 bytes: 160-byte next state, append disposition, cleanup mask, action, operand and zero reserved word.
interface.validation: Validate full source/state/event/component frame before checking output>=200, then before any output write. Reserved words, phase/action facts, booleans, indices, sequence overflow and exact frame end are checked. Errors do not write. Each accepted event increments sequence once; BEGIN starts at1.
interface.workspace: Untouched on every call; source, output and workspace are live disjoint ranges for the synchronous call.
interface.transport: 512-byte stack frame with checked Vec spill; no native error becomes an unmatched result.

behavior.hia_owns: Exact/host/fallback routing; ordered rule ordinals, all-path admission and component equality, first equal-path stop, match retention/annotation, cleanup scheduling and fallback invocation decision.
behavior.rust_retains: Real containers/lookups, arbitrary Rule::matches and heuristic callbacks, owned results, original OS path services, Path::components encoding and check_multiple iterator/AsRef/Drop effects.
behavior.ordering: Any exact Some suppresses host/fallback, but selected bucket callbacks stay exhaustive and ordered. Missing and present-empty buckets remain distinct. Fallback clones the original command before callback.
behavior.metadata: Host PrefixRuleMatch gets the resolved program; HeuristicsRuleMatch metadata is retained. Returned owned objects remain independent.
behavior.failure: Invalid statuses/state/structural replies panic without Rust fallback. Already performed callback effects cannot be rolled back; semantically wrong but structurally valid replies require the real HIA/original differential.

interface.source: Complete borrowed raw UTF-8 bytes, without a length prefix or input copy.
interface.control: Exactly 32 read-only workspace bytes: LE u64 version=1, mode, expected_length, reserved=0.
interface.plan: mode=0 requires expected_length=0; success writes 16 bytes containing LE u64 semantic_tag and result_byte_length.
interface.run: mode=1 requires 0<expected_length<=source_length, repeats complete validation/normalization and requires semantic success plus the exact planned length before writing the normalized bytes.

interface.transport: Rust borrows the input, uses a 16-byte stack plan, validates tag/length/status and unchanged 32-byte control, allocates the returned String, and preserves original error-object construction. A native contract failure panics; no fallback or no-match conversion.
interface.target: Existing opt-in Linux x86-64 GNU profile; buffers must remain live and disjoint for each synchronous call.

behavior.rust_retains: Owned String/error allocation, original public callers/parser validation and policy/file effects. No IP parser, DNS, IDNA, Unicode case folding, port-range validation or general network I/O is introduced.
